SASBDB entry SASDEP6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDEP6/)

Publication: Molecular Fingerprints for a Novel Enzyme Family in Actinobacteria with Glucosamine Kinase Activity
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1128/mBio.00239-19

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDEP6/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
